behavior_constraints: `--rejects-format` accepts exactly one of {legacy, tagged, tagged-sorted}; default/omitted is legacy.

Invalid `--rejects-format` value (empty, prefix, case variant, any other token) → exit 2, no output files, stderr line exactly: `ingest: --rejects-format: must be one of {legacy, tagged, tagged-sorted}`.
`--rejects-format` missing its argument value → exit 2 (Go flag parser usage error).
`--rejects-format tagged` (or tagged-sorted) without `--audit-log` → exit 2, no output files, stderr line exactly: `ingest: --rejects-format tagged requires --audit-log`.
`--rejects-format-header` is a valueless boolean flag; supplying `=value` → exit 2 (Go flag parser error).
`--rejects-format-header` without `--rejects-format tagged` or `tagged-sorted` → exit 2, no output files, stderr line exactly: `ingest: --rejects-format-header requires --rejects-format tagged`.
Validation order: enum-value check at parse time; both dependency checks run before any output file (including `.tmp`) is written.
`legacy` format (default or explicit) is byte-for-byte identical to existing rejects output, with and without `--dedup-policy first-arrival`.
`tagged` format: every non-empty reject is one line terminated by exactly one `\n`; no leading/trailing blank lines.
Tagged column layout (no first-arrival dedup): exactly 5 tab-separated columns `<bucket>\t<reason_code>\t<shard>\t<line_no>\t<raw_line>\n`.
affected_prior: writeAuditLog / audit-log feature (round 3) — tagged rejects is a projection of audit-log reject records
buildManifest / writeManifest / writeSignature (round 5) — manifest/signature must reflect chosen rejects bytes
schema sidecar digest (round 8) — schema/digest must reflect chosen rejects bytes
ingest (rounds 4, 7) — flow must plumb rejects-format config
entities.summary: Round 9 adds a `--rejects-format <legacy|tagged|tagged-sorted>` selector and `--rejects-format-header` flag to `eventq ingest`, emitting a canonical tab-separated tagged rejects file (projected from audit-log reject records) with strict validation, while keeping legacy output byte-identical and ensuring digest/schema/manifest/signature reflect the chosen rejects bytes.

instruction_head:
# Canonical Rejects Formats

The existing `--rejects` file records rejected raw lines, but it does not by
itself expose the reject bucket, reason code, shard, or line number for each
row. Add an explicit `--rejects-format <legacy|tagged|tagged-sorted>` selector
and a canonical tagged shape so downstream consumers can read that metadata
without replaying the pipeline or cross-referencing the audit log.

`legacy` is the default and preserves the existing on-disk reject bytes.
`tagged` emits bucket
